name: WordPress
description: Open source publishing software that powers a large share of the web.
summary: AI tools may assist with code, tests, docs and issues. Contributors must understand and review every line, keep everything GPL-compatible, and disclose meaningful AI help in the PR description or Trac ticket. AI may draft issue and PR descriptions if the details are reviewed and verified.

evidence.quote: AI tools can assist, but they are not contributors.
When AI meaningfully contributes to your work (beyond trivial reformatting), clearly mention that in your:
Do not use tools whose terms forbid using their output in GPL-licensed projects or impose additional restrictions on redistribution.
Treat AI output like code from an unknown external contributor: you must review and validate it before sharing it.
You may draft descriptions with AI.
Reproduce the issue on real WordPress installs.
Ask AI to summarize a change, then correct and extend that summary.
